notes: Firm, dated promises by the user, all High. T-G9, T-G11, T-G7, T-G16: none of the trailing wordings is a condition. 'call Priya' is an instruction to Sam if something is urgent, not a loop.

items.title: Send Sam the volunteer list
items.quote: I'll send you the volunteer list on Tuesday, once I get a chance.

items.title: Email the vendors the map
items.quote: I'll email the vendors the map on Monday, once the week's over.

items.title: Call Sam
items.quote: I'll call you Friday. If it's urgent call Priya instead.
items.note: The 'if' is its own instruction in the next sentence. Live, the model quoted only the first sentence (same item, High), so that span is an alternate.

items.title: Drop off the cash box
items.quote: I'll drop off the cash box on Thursday, if that's fine.
